(function () {
  'use strict';
  async function json(url, init) {
    const controller = new AbortController(), timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 15000);
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, { ...init, signal: controller.signal, credentials: 'omit' });
      const data = await response.json();
      if (!response.ok || data.errors) {
        const error = new Error(data.error || data.errors?.[0]?.message || '请求失败，请稍后重试');
        error.status = response.status; throw error;
      }
      return data;
    } finally { clearTimeout(timer); }
  }
  function headers(token) { return { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {}) }; }
  async function github(query, variables, token) {
    return json('https://api.github.com/graphql', { method: 'POST', headers: headers(token), body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }) });
  }
  window.BlogGiscusAPI = {
    load(id, token, after) { return json('/api/todo-giscus/' + id + (after ? '?after=' + encodeURIComponent(after) : ''), { headers: token ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token } : {} }); },
    token(session) { return json('/api/todo-giscus/token', { method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ session }) }); },
    create(id, token) { return json('/api/todo-giscus/' + id, { method: 'POST', headers: headers(token), body: '{}' }); },
    add(discussionId, body, replyToId, token) {
      return github('mutation($discussionId:ID!,$body:String!,$replyToId:ID){addDiscussionComment(input:{discussionId:$discussionId,body:$body,replyToId:$replyToId}){comment{id}}}', { discussionId, body, replyToId: replyToId || null }, token);
    },
    body(id, token) { return github('query($id:ID!){node(id:$id){... on DiscussionComment{body}}}',{id},token); },
    edit(commentId, body, token) { return github('mutation($commentId:ID!,$body:String!){updateDiscussionComment(input:{commentId:$commentId,body:$body}){comment{id}}}', {commentId,body},token); },
    remove(id, token) { return github('mutation($id:ID!){deleteDiscussionComment(input:{id:$id}){clientMutationId}}',{id},token); },
    reaction(subjectId, content, remove, token) {
      return github('mutation($subjectId:ID!,$content:ReactionContent!){'+(remove?'removeReaction':'addReaction')+'(input:{subjectId:$subjectId,content:$content}){reaction{id}}}',{subjectId,content},token);
    }
  };
})();
